method: Fixed 17-case corpus, then 4 selected cases repeated twice with alternating request order. API-reported usage covers complete system and user prompts, with no automatic retries. Input and total counts are reported separately; repeated cases have extra weight in combined totals.
retentionCriteria: Every requested pair has strictly fewer prompt tokens; protected-only cases make no calls in either variant.
Each provider has lower total tokens in each of the initial and focused cohorts.
Every candidate completes and passes local reconstruction and protected-text checks.
agentSemanticReview: Recorded translations compared for meaning, negation, numbers and obvious new regressions; no new obvious candidate regression identified. One OpenAI baseline mysql-url repeat dropped unmarked JSON_*; the candidate retained it. This is agent inspection, not human release acceptance.
